mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% in a month signals a tightening monetary policy, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as borrowing costs rise and economic activity slows.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where FEDFUNDS increased by more than 0.5% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in a month indicates a weakening labor market, which historically correlates with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors react to the economic slowdown.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where UNRATE increased by more than 0.5% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP (GDPC1) over two consecutive quarters signals a weakening demand environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings are expected to decline.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances where GDPC1 declined over two consecutive quarters.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in a month signals a strengthening supply side, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as economic activity accelerates.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where INDPRO increased by more than 1% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 in a month, it signals a strong labor market, which historically correlates with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as consumer spending is expected to rise.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where PAYEMS increased by more than 200,000 in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 10% in a month signals a strong demand for housing, which historically correlates with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as it indicates a robust economic environment.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where HOUST increased by more than 10% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 5% and the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) increases by more than 0.5% in a month, it signals an inflationary environment with tight monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 5% and CPIAUCSL increase > 0.5% in 1 month
regime_hint: inflationary period with tight monetary policy
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances where FEDFUNDS > 5% and CPIAUCSL increased by more than 0.5% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: When real GDP (GDPC1) declines and retail and food services sales (RSAFS) also decline in the same month, it signals a broad-based weakening of demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as economic activity slows.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 and RSAFS both decline in the same month
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances where GDPC1 and RSAFS both declined in the same month.
